+__device__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t sample01(uint32_t i, uint32_t j, uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    uint32_t x = 42U ^ (i * 0x9e3779b9U) ^ (j * 0x85ebca6bU) ^
+                 (ray * 0xc2b2ae35U) ^ (lane * 0x27d4eb2fU);
+    return static_cast<val_t>(mixBits(x) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 sampledPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint32_t i, uint32_t j,
+                             uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    val_t u = sample01(i, j, ray, lane);
+    val_t v = sample01(i, j, ray, lane + 1U);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool segmentIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                     const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    return fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) <=
+           node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceRayTriangle(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                   const Triangle& triangle) {
+    Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 p = direction.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(p);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tv = origin - triangle.a;
+    val_t u = tv.dot(p) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    Vec3 q = tv.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = direction.dot(q) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return e2.dot(q) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                 const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices,
+                                 uint32_t triangleCount, uint32_t src, uint32_t dst) {
+    Vec3 delta = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = delta.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 direction = delta / rayLength;
+    // The generated octree is shallow; the guarded stack avoids recursion and
+    // falls back to a complete scan if a future mesh produces excessive fanout.
+    int stack[64];
+    int top = 0;
+    stack[top++] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                uint32_t index = indices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && segmentIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (top == 64) {
+                        // Correctness-preserving rare overflow path.
+                        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < triangleCount; ++index) {
+                            if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                            val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+                        }
+                        return false;
+                    }
+                    stack[top++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices, size_t n,
+                                 size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                 val_t* kij, int* tau) {
+    size_t linear = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    size_t total = rowCount * n;
+    if (linear >= total) return;
+    size_t localI = linear / n;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    size_t j = linear - localI * n;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        tau[linear] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 centers = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[linear] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(centers.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    if (triangles[i].normal().dot(triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t factor = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pi = sampledPoint(triangles[i], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 0);
+        Vec3 pj = sampledPoint(triangles[j], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 2);
+        if (rayBlockedDevice(pi, pj, triangles, nodes, indices, static_cast<uint32_t>(n),
+                             static_cast<uint32_t>(i), static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) continue;
+        Vec3 v = pj - pi;
+        val_t distance2 = v.squaredNorm();
+        if (distance2 < EPSILON) continue;
+        val_t inverseLength = rsqrtf(distance2);
+        val_t ci = fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(triangles[i].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        val_t cj = fmaxf(ZERO, (-v).dot(triangles[j].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        if (ci > ZERO && cj > ZERO) factor += ci * cj / (PI * distance2);
+    }
+    kij[linear] = factor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(size_t n, size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                  size_t timestep, const val_t* kij,
+                                  const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                  const val_t* rho, const val_t* allRadiosity,
+                                  size_t source, size_t sourceOff, val_t* current) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    size_t row = localI * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        int delay = tau[row + j];
+        val_t factor = kij[row + j];
+        if (i == j || timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay) || factor <= ZERO) continue;
+        val_t incoming = allRadiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];
+        if (incoming > ZERO) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], ONE) * incoming;
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t partial[256];
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        current[localI] = rho[i] * partial[0] +
+                          ((i == source && timestep < sourceOff) ? ONE : ZERO);
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t rowStart,
+                               size_t rowCount, size_t source,
+                               const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t threadBest = ZERO;
+    size_t threadBestT = 0;
+    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t tt = t; tt < timesteps; ++tt) {
+            sum += radiosity[tt * n + i] * radiosity[(tt - t) * n + source];
+        }
+        if (sum > threadBest) {
+            threadBest = sum;
+            threadBestT = t;
+        }
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t correlations[256];
+    __shared__ size_t delays[256];
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = threadBest;
+    delays[threadIdx.x] = threadBestT;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t candidate = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            size_t candidateT = delays[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidate > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidate == correlations[threadIdx.x] && candidateT < delays[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = candidate;
+                delays[threadIdx.x] = candidateT;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(delays[0]);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    unsigned int local = index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON;
+    // Aggregate within a block to keep validation overhead negligible.
+    __shared__ unsigned int blockCount[256];
+    blockCount[threadIdx.x] = local;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) blockCount[threadIdx.x] += blockCount[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) atomicAdd(nonzero, static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockCount[0]));
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergizedKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t n,
+                                     size_t timesteps, unsigned int* energized) {
+    size_t triangle = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * n + triangle] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(energized, 1U);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA kernels
+// ============================================================================
+
+__device__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t sample01(uint32_t i, uint32_t j, uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    uint32_t x = 42U ^ (i * 0x9e3779b9U) ^ (j * 0x85ebca6bU) ^
+                 (ray * 0xc2b2ae35U) ^ (lane * 0x27d4eb2fU);
+    return static_cast<val_t>(mixBits(x) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 sampledPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint32_t i, uint32_t j,
+                             uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    val_t u = sample01(i, j, ray, lane);
+    val_t v = sample01(i, j, ray, lane + 1U);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool segmentIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                     const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    return fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) <=
+           node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceRayTriangle(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                   const Triangle& triangle) {
+    Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 p = direction.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(p);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tv = origin - triangle.a;
+    val_t u = tv.dot(p) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    Vec3 q = tv.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = direction.dot(q) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return e2.dot(q) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                 const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices,
+                                 uint32_t triangleCount, uint32_t src, uint32_t dst) {
+    Vec3 delta = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = delta.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 direction = delta / rayLength;
+    // The generated octree is shallow; the guarded stack avoids recursion and
+    // falls back to a complete scan if a future mesh produces excessive fanout.
+    int stack[64];
+    int top = 0;
+    stack[top++] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                uint32_t index = indices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && segmentIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (top == 64) {
+                        // Correctness-preserving rare overflow path.
+                        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < triangleCount; ++index) {
+                            if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                            val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+                        }
+                        return false;
+                    }
+                    stack[top++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices, size_t n,
+                                 size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                 val_t* kij, int* tau) {
+    size_t linear = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    size_t total = rowCount * n;
+    if (linear >= total) return;
+    size_t localI = linear / n;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    size_t j = linear - localI * n;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        tau[linear] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 centers = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[linear] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(centers.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    if (triangles[i].normal().dot(triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t factor = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pi = sampledPoint(triangles[i], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 0);
+        Vec3 pj = sampledPoint(triangles[j], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 2);
+        if (rayBlockedDevice(pi, pj, triangles, nodes, indices, static_cast<uint32_t>(n),
+                             static_cast<uint32_t>(i), static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) continue;
+        Vec3 v = pj - pi;
+        val_t distance2 = v.squaredNorm();
+        if (distance2 < EPSILON) continue;
+        val_t inverseLength = rsqrtf(distance2);
+        val_t ci = fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(triangles[i].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        val_t cj = fmaxf(ZERO, (-v).dot(triangles[j].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        if (ci > ZERO && cj > ZERO) factor += ci * cj / (PI * distance2);
+    }
+    kij[linear] = factor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(size_t n, size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                  size_t timestep, const val_t* kij,
+                                  const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                  const val_t* rho, const val_t* allRadiosity,
+                                  size_t source, size_t sourceOff, val_t* current) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    size_t row = localI * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        int delay = tau[row + j];
+        val_t factor = kij[row + j];
+        if (i == j || timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay) || factor <= ZERO) continue;
+        val_t incoming = allRadiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];
+        if (incoming > ZERO) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], ONE) * incoming;
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t partial[256];
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        current[localI] = rho[i] * partial[0] +
+                          ((i == source && timestep < sourceOff) ? ONE : ZERO);
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t rowStart,
+                               size_t rowCount, size_t source,
+                               const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t threadBest = ZERO;
+    size_t threadBestT = 0;
+    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t tt = t; tt < timesteps; ++tt) {
+            sum += radiosity[tt * n + i] * radiosity[(tt - t) * n + source];
+        }
+        if (sum > threadBest) {
+            threadBest = sum;
+            threadBestT = t;
+        }
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t correlations[256];
+    __shared__ size_t delays[256];
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = threadBest;
+    delays[threadIdx.x] = threadBestT;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t candidate = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            size_t candidateT = delays[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidate > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidate == correlations[threadIdx.x] && candidateT < delays[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = candidate;
+                delays[threadIdx.x] = candidateT;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(delays[0]);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    unsigned int local = index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON;
+    // Aggregate within a block to keep validation overhead negligible.
+    __shared__ unsigned int blockCount[256];
+    blockCount[threadIdx.x] = local;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) blockCount[threadIdx.x] += blockCount[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) atomicAdd(nonzero, static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockCount[0]));
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergizedKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t n,
+                                     size_t timesteps, unsigned int* energized) {
+    size_t triangle = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * n + triangle] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(energized, 1U);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA kernels
+// ============================================================================
+
+__device__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t sample01(uint32_t i, uint32_t j, uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    uint32_t x = 42U ^ (i * 0x9e3779b9U) ^ (j * 0x85ebca6bU) ^
+                 (ray * 0xc2b2ae35U) ^ (lane * 0x27d4eb2fU);
+    return static_cast<val_t>(mixBits(x) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 sampledPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint32_t i, uint32_t j,
+                             uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    val_t u = sample01(i, j, ray, lane);
+    val_t v = sample01(i, j, ray, lane + 1U);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool segmentIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                     const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    return fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) <=
+           node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceRayTriangle(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                   const Triangle& triangle) {
+    Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 p = direction.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(p);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tv = origin - triangle.a;
+    val_t u = tv.dot(p) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    Vec3 q = tv.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = direction.dot(q) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return e2.dot(q) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                 const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices,
+                                 uint32_t triangleCount, uint32_t src, uint32_t dst) {
+    Vec3 delta = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = delta.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 direction = delta / rayLength;
+    // The generated octree is shallow; the guarded stack avoids recursion and
+    // falls back to a complete scan if a future mesh produces excessive fanout.
+    int stack[64];
+    int top = 0;
+    stack[top++] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                uint32_t index = indices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && segmentIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (top == 64) {
+                        // Correctness-preserving rare overflow path.
+                        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < triangleCount; ++index) {
+                            if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                            val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+                        }
+                        return false;
+                    }
+                    stack[top++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices, size_t n,
+                                 size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                 val_t* kij, int* tau) {
+    size_t linear = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    size_t total = rowCount * n;
+    if (linear >= total) return;
+    size_t localI = linear / n;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    size_t j = linear - localI * n;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        tau[linear] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 centers = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[linear] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(centers.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    if (triangles[i].normal().dot(triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t factor = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pi = sampledPoint(triangles[i], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 0);
+        Vec3 pj = sampledPoint(triangles[j], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 2);
+        if (rayBlockedDevice(pi, pj, triangles, nodes, indices, static_cast<uint32_t>(n),
+                             static_cast<uint32_t>(i), static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) continue;
+        Vec3 v = pj - pi;
+        val_t distance2 = v.squaredNorm();
+        if (distance2 < EPSILON) continue;
+        val_t inverseLength = rsqrtf(distance2);
+        val_t ci = fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(triangles[i].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        val_t cj = fmaxf(ZERO, (-v).dot(triangles[j].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        if (ci > ZERO && cj > ZERO) factor += ci * cj / (PI * distance2);
+    }
+    kij[linear] = factor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(size_t n, size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                  size_t timestep, const val_t* kij,
+                                  const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                  const val_t* rho, const val_t* allRadiosity,
+                                  size_t source, size_t sourceOff, val_t* current) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    size_t row = localI * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        int delay = tau[row + j];
+        val_t factor = kij[row + j];
+        if (i == j || timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay) || factor <= ZERO) continue;
+        val_t incoming = allRadiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];
+        if (incoming > ZERO) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], ONE) * incoming;
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t partial[256];
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        current[localI] = rho[i] * partial[0] +
+                          ((i == source && timestep < sourceOff) ? ONE : ZERO);
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t rowStart,
+                               size_t rowCount, size_t source,
+                               const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t threadBest = ZERO;
+    size_t threadBestT = 0;
+    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t tt = t; tt < timesteps; ++tt) {
+            sum += radiosity[tt * n + i] * radiosity[(tt - t) * n + source];
+        }
+        if (sum > threadBest) {
+            threadBest = sum;
+            threadBestT = t;
+        }
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t correlations[256];
+    __shared__ size_t delays[256];
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = threadBest;
+    delays[threadIdx.x] = threadBestT;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t candidate = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            size_t candidateT = delays[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidate > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidate == correlations[threadIdx.x] && candidateT < delays[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = candidate;
+                delays[threadIdx.x] = candidateT;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(delays[0]);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    unsigned int local = index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON;
+    // Aggregate within a block to keep validation overhead negligible.
+    __shared__ unsigned int blockCount[256];
+    blockCount[threadIdx.x] = local;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) blockCount[threadIdx.x] += blockCount[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) atomicAdd(nonzero, static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockCount[0]));
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergizedKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t n,
+                                     size_t timesteps, unsigned int* energized) {
+    size_t triangle = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * n + triangle] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(energized, 1U);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}

+    cudaCheck(cudaHostAlloc(&state.hostCurrent, n * sizeof(val_t), cudaHostAllocPortable), "MPI receive staging allocation");
+    cudaCheck(cudaHostAlloc(&state.hostLocal, state.localCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaHostAllocPortable), "MPI send staging allocation");
+    cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriangles, state.triangles.data(), n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice), "triangle upload");

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA kernels

+__device__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t sample01(uint32_t i, uint32_t j, uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    uint32_t x = 42U ^ (i * 0x9e3779b9U) ^ (j * 0x85ebca6bU) ^
+                 (ray * 0xc2b2ae35U) ^ (lane * 0x27d4eb2fU);
+    return static_cast<val_t>(mixBits(x) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 sampledPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint32_t i, uint32_t j,
+                             uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    val_t u = sample01(i, j, ray, lane);
+    val_t v = sample01(i, j, ray, lane + 1U);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool segmentIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                     const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    return fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) <=
+           node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceRayTriangle(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                   const Triangle& triangle) {
+    Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 p = direction.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(p);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tv = origin - triangle.a;
+    val_t u = tv.dot(p) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    Vec3 q = tv.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = direction.dot(q) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return e2.dot(q) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                 const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices,
+                                 uint32_t triangleCount, uint32_t src, uint32_t dst) {
+    Vec3 delta = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = delta.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 direction = delta / rayLength;
+    // The generated octree is shallow; the guarded stack avoids recursion and
+    // falls back to a complete scan if a future mesh produces excessive fanout.
+    int stack[64];
+    int top = 0;
+    stack[top++] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                uint32_t index = indices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && segmentIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (top == 64) {
+                        // Correctness-preserving rare overflow path.
+                        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < triangleCount; ++index) {
+                            if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                            val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+                        }
+                        return false;
+                    }
+                    stack[top++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices, size_t n,
+                                 size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                 val_t* kij, int* tau) {
+    size_t linear = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    size_t total = rowCount * n;
+    if (linear >= total) return;
+    size_t localI = linear / n;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    size_t j = linear - localI * n;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        tau[linear] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 centers = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[linear] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(centers.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    if (triangles[i].normal().dot(triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t factor = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pi = sampledPoint(triangles[i], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 0);
+        Vec3 pj = sampledPoint(triangles[j], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 2);
+        if (rayBlockedDevice(pi, pj, triangles, nodes, indices, static_cast<uint32_t>(n),
+                             static_cast<uint32_t>(i), static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) continue;
+        Vec3 v = pj - pi;
+        val_t distance2 = v.squaredNorm();
+        if (distance2 < EPSILON) continue;
+        val_t inverseLength = rsqrtf(distance2);
+        val_t ci = fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(triangles[i].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        val_t cj = fmaxf(ZERO, (-v).dot(triangles[j].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        if (ci > ZERO && cj > ZERO) factor += ci * cj / (PI * distance2);
+    }
+    kij[linear] = factor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(size_t n, size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                  size_t timestep, const val_t* kij,
+                                  const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                  const val_t* rho, const val_t* allRadiosity,
+                                  size_t source, size_t sourceOff, val_t* current) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    size_t row = localI * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        int delay = tau[row + j];
+        val_t factor = kij[row + j];
+        if (i == j || timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay) || factor <= ZERO) continue;
+        val_t incoming = allRadiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];
+        if (incoming > ZERO) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], ONE) * incoming;
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t partial[256];
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        current[localI] = rho[i] * partial[0] +
+                          ((i == source && timestep < sourceOff) ? ONE : ZERO);
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t rowStart,
+                               size_t rowCount, size_t source,
+                               const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t threadBest = ZERO;
+    size_t threadBestT = 0;
+    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t tt = t; tt < timesteps; ++tt) {
+            sum += radiosity[tt * n + i] * radiosity[(tt - t) * n + source];
+        }
+        if (sum > threadBest) {
+            threadBest = sum;
+            threadBestT = t;
+        }
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t correlations[256];
+    __shared__ size_t delays[256];
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = threadBest;
+    delays[threadIdx.x] = threadBestT;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t candidate = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            size_t candidateT = delays[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidate > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidate == correlations[threadIdx.x] && candidateT < delays[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = candidate;
+                delays[threadIdx.x] = candidateT;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(delays[0]);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    unsigned int local = index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON;
+    // Aggregate within a block to keep validation overhead negligible.
+    __shared__ unsigned int blockCount[256];
+    blockCount[threadIdx.x] = local;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) blockCount[threadIdx.x] += blockCount[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) atomicAdd(nonzero, static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockCount[0]));
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergizedKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t n,
+                                     size_t timesteps, unsigned int* energized) {
+    size_t triangle = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * n + triangle] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(energized, 1U);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}

+__device__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t sample01(uint32_t i, uint32_t j, uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    uint32_t x = 42U ^ (i * 0x9e3779b9U) ^ (j * 0x85ebca6bU) ^
+                 (ray * 0xc2b2ae35U) ^ (lane * 0x27d4eb2fU);
+    return static_cast<val_t>(mixBits(x) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 sampledPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint32_t i, uint32_t j,
+                             uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    val_t u = sample01(i, j, ray, lane);
+    val_t v = sample01(i, j, ray, lane + 1U);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool segmentIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                     const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    return fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) <=
+           node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceRayTriangle(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                   const Triangle& triangle) {
+    Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 p = direction.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(p);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tv = origin - triangle.a;
+    val_t u = tv.dot(p) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    Vec3 q = tv.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = direction.dot(q) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return e2.dot(q) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                 const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices,
+                                 uint32_t triangleCount, uint32_t src, uint32_t dst) {
+    Vec3 delta = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = delta.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 direction = delta / rayLength;
+    // The generated octree is shallow; the guarded stack avoids recursion and
+    // falls back to a complete scan if a future mesh produces excessive fanout.
+    int stack[64];
+    int top = 0;
+    stack[top++] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                uint32_t index = indices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && segmentIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (top == 64) {
+                        // Correctness-preserving rare overflow path.
+                        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < triangleCount; ++index) {
+                            if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                            val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+                        }
+                        return false;
+                    }
+                    stack[top++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices, size_t n,
+                                 size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                 val_t* kij, int* tau) {
+    size_t linear = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    size_t total = rowCount * n;
+    if (linear >= total) return;
+    size_t localI = linear / n;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    size_t j = linear - localI * n;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        tau[linear] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 centers = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[linear] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(centers.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    if (triangles[i].normal().dot(triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t factor = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pi = sampledPoint(triangles[i], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 0);
+        Vec3 pj = sampledPoint(triangles[j], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 2);
+        if (rayBlockedDevice(pi, pj, triangles, nodes, indices, static_cast<uint32_t>(n),
+                             static_cast<uint32_t>(i), static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) continue;
+        Vec3 v = pj - pi;
+        val_t distance2 = v.squaredNorm();
+        if (distance2 < EPSILON) continue;
+        val_t inverseLength = rsqrtf(distance2);
+        val_t ci = fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(triangles[i].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        val_t cj = fmaxf(ZERO, (-v).dot(triangles[j].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        if (ci > ZERO && cj > ZERO) factor += ci * cj / (PI * distance2);
+    }
+    kij[linear] = factor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(size_t n, size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                  size_t timestep, const val_t* kij,
+                                  const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                  const val_t* rho, const val_t* allRadiosity,
+                                  size_t source, size_t sourceOff, val_t* current) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    size_t row = localI * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        int delay = tau[row + j];
+        val_t factor = kij[row + j];
+        if (i == j || timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay) || factor <= ZERO) continue;
+        val_t incoming = allRadiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];
+        if (incoming > ZERO) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], ONE) * incoming;
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t partial[256];
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        current[localI] = rho[i] * partial[0] +
+                          ((i == source && timestep < sourceOff) ? ONE : ZERO);
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t rowStart,
+                               size_t rowCount, size_t source,
+                               const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t threadBest = ZERO;
+    size_t threadBestT = 0;
+    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t tt = t; tt < timesteps; ++tt) {
+            sum += radiosity[tt * n + i] * radiosity[(tt - t) * n + source];
+        }
+        if (sum > threadBest) {
+            threadBest = sum;
+            threadBestT = t;
+        }
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t correlations[256];
+    __shared__ size_t delays[256];
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = threadBest;
+    delays[threadIdx.x] = threadBestT;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t candidate = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            size_t candidateT = delays[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidate > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidate == correlations[threadIdx.x] && candidateT < delays[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = candidate;
+                delays[threadIdx.x] = candidateT;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(delays[0]);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    unsigned int local = index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON;
+    // Aggregate within a block to keep validation overhead negligible.
+    __shared__ unsigned int blockCount[256];
+    blockCount[threadIdx.x] = local;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) blockCount[threadIdx.x] += blockCount[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) atomicAdd(nonzero, static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockCount[0]));
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergizedKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t n,
+                                     size_t timesteps, unsigned int* energized) {
+    size_t triangle = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * n + triangle] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(energized, 1U);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}

+// CUDA kernels

+__device__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t sample01(uint32_t i, uint32_t j, uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    uint32_t x = 42U ^ (i * 0x9e3779b9U) ^ (j * 0x85ebca6bU) ^
+                 (ray * 0xc2b2ae35U) ^ (lane * 0x27d4eb2fU);
+    return static_cast<val_t>(mixBits(x) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 sampledPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint32_t i, uint32_t j,
+                             uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    val_t u = sample01(i, j, ray, lane);
+    val_t v = sample01(i, j, ray, lane + 1U);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool segmentIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                     const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    return fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) <=
+           node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceRayTriangle(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                   const Triangle& triangle) {
+    Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 p = direction.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(p);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tv = origin - triangle.a;
+    val_t u = tv.dot(p) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    Vec3 q = tv.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = direction.dot(q) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return e2.dot(q) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                 const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices,
+                                 uint32_t triangleCount, uint32_t src, uint32_t dst) {
+    Vec3 delta = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = delta.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 direction = delta / rayLength;
+    // The generated octree is shallow; the guarded stack avoids recursion and
+    // falls back to a complete scan if a future mesh produces excessive fanout.
+    int stack[64];
+    int top = 0;
+    stack[top++] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                uint32_t index = indices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && segmentIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (top == 64) {
+                        // Correctness-preserving rare overflow path.
+                        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < triangleCount; ++index) {
+                            if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                            val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+                        }
+                        return false;
+                    }
+                    stack[top++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices, size_t n,
+                                 size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                 val_t* kij, int* tau) {
+    size_t linear = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    size_t total = rowCount * n;
+    if (linear >= total) return;
+    size_t localI = linear / n;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    size_t j = linear - localI * n;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        tau[linear] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 centers = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[linear] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(centers.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    if (triangles[i].normal().dot(triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t factor = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pi = sampledPoint(triangles[i], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 0);
+        Vec3 pj = sampledPoint(triangles[j], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 2);
+        if (rayBlockedDevice(pi, pj, triangles, nodes, indices, static_cast<uint32_t>(n),
+                             static_cast<uint32_t>(i), static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) continue;
+        Vec3 v = pj - pi;
+        val_t distance2 = v.squaredNorm();
+        if (distance2 < EPSILON) continue;
+        val_t inverseLength = rsqrtf(distance2);
+        val_t ci = fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(triangles[i].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        val_t cj = fmaxf(ZERO, (-v).dot(triangles[j].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        if (ci > ZERO && cj > ZERO) factor += ci * cj / (PI * distance2);
+    }
+    kij[linear] = factor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(size_t n, size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                  size_t timestep, const val_t* kij,
+                                  const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                  const val_t* rho, const val_t* allRadiosity,
+                                  size_t source, size_t sourceOff, val_t* current) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    size_t row = localI * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        int delay = tau[row + j];
+        val_t factor = kij[row + j];
+        if (i == j || timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay) || factor <= ZERO) continue;
+        val_t incoming = allRadiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];
+        if (incoming > ZERO) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], ONE) * incoming;
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t partial[256];
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        current[localI] = rho[i] * partial[0] +
+                          ((i == source && timestep < sourceOff) ? ONE : ZERO);
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t rowStart,
+                               size_t rowCount, size_t source,
+                               const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t threadBest = ZERO;
+    size_t threadBestT = 0;
+    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t tt = t; tt < timesteps; ++tt) {
+            sum += radiosity[tt * n + i] * radiosity[(tt - t) * n + source];
+        }
+        if (sum > threadBest) {
+            threadBest = sum;
+            threadBestT = t;
+        }
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t correlations[256];
+    __shared__ size_t delays[256];
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = threadBest;
+    delays[threadIdx.x] = threadBestT;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t candidate = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            size_t candidateT = delays[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidate > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidate == correlations[threadIdx.x] && candidateT < delays[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = candidate;
+                delays[threadIdx.x] = candidateT;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(delays[0]);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    unsigned int local = index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON;
+    // Aggregate within a block to keep validation overhead negligible.
+    __shared__ unsigned int blockCount[256];
+    blockCount[threadIdx.x] = local;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) blockCount[threadIdx.x] += blockCount[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) atomicAdd(nonzero, static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockCount[0]));
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergizedKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t n,
+                                     size_t timesteps, unsigned int* energized) {
+    size_t triangle = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * n + triangle] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(energized, 1U);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}

   582	__device__ Vec3 sampledPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint32_t i, uint32_t j,

   594	__device__ bool segmentIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
   595	                                     const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
   596	    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
   597	    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
   598	    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
   599	    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
   600	        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
   601	        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
   602	    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
   603	        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
   604	    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
   605	        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
   606	    return fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) <=
   607	           node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON;
   608	}

   610	__device__ val_t deviceRayTriangle(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
   611	                                   const Triangle& triangle) {
   612	    Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
   613	    Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
   614	    Vec3 p = direction.cross(e2);
   615	    val_t det = e1.dot(p);
   616	    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
   617	    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
   618	    Vec3 tv = origin - triangle.a;
   619	    val_t u = tv.dot(p) * invDet;
   620	    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
   621	    Vec3 q = tv.cross(e1);
   622	    val_t v = direction.dot(q) * invDet;
   623	    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
   624	    return e2.dot(q) * invDet;

   627	__device__ bool rayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
   628	                                 const Triangle* triangles,
   629	                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
   630	                                 const uint32_t* indices,
   631	                                 uint32_t triangleCount, uint32_t src, uint32_t dst) {
   632	    Vec3 delta = to - from;
   633	    val_t rayLength = delta.norm();
   634	    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
   635	    Vec3 direction = delta / rayLength;
   636	    // The generated octree is shallow; the guarded stack avoids recursion and
   637	    // falls back to a complete scan if a future mesh produces excessive fanout.
   638	    int stack[64];
   639	    int top = 0;
   640	    stack[top++] = 0;
   641	    while (top) {
   642	        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
   643	        if (node.triangleCount) {
   644	            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
   645	                uint32_t index = indices[node.firstTriangle + k];
   646	                if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
   647	                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
   648	                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
   649	            }
   650	        } else {
   651	            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
   652	                int childIndex = node.children[child];
   653	                if (childIndex >= 0 && segmentIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
   654	                    if (top == 64) {
   655	                        // Correctness-preserving rare overflow path.
   656	                        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < triangleCount; ++index) {
   657	                            if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
   658	                            val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
   659	                            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
   660	                        }
   661	                        return false;
   662	                    }
   663	                    stack[top++] = childIndex;
   664	                }
   665	            }
   666	        }
   667	    }
   668	    return false;
   669	}
   670	
   671	__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
   672	                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
   673	                                 const uint32_t* indices, size_t n,
   674	                                 size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
   675	                                 val_t* kij, int* tau) {
   676	    size_t linear = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   677	    size_t total = rowCount * n;
   678	    if (linear >= total) return;
   679	    size_t localI = linear / n;
   680	    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
   681	    size_t j = linear - localI * n;
   682	    if (i == j) {
   683	        kij[linear] = ZERO;
   684	        tau[linear] = 0;
   685	        return;
   686	    }
   687	    Vec3 centers = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
   688	    tau[linear] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(centers.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
   689	    if (triangles[i].normal().dot(triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) {
   690	        kij[linear] = ZERO;
   691	        return;
   692	    }
   693	    val_t factor = ZERO;
   694	    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
   695	        Vec3 pi = sampledPoint(triangles[i], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
   696	                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 0);
   697	        Vec3 pj = sampledPoint(triangles[j], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
   698	                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 2);
   699	        if (rayBlockedDevice(pi, pj, triangles, nodes, indices, static_cast<uint32_t>(n),
   700	                             static_cast<uint32_t>(i), static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) continue;
   701	        Vec3 v = pj - pi;
   702	        val_t distance2 = v.squaredNorm();
   703	        if (distance2 < EPSILON) continue;
   704	        val_t inverseLength = rsqrtf(distance2);
   705	        val_t ci = fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(triangles[i].normal()) * inverseLength);
   706	        val_t cj = fmaxf(ZERO, (-v).dot(triangles[j].normal()) * inverseLength);
   707	        if (ci > ZERO && cj > ZERO) factor += ci * cj / (PI * distance2);
   708	    }
   709	    kij[linear] = factor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
   710	}
   711	
   712	__global__ void propagationKernel(size_t n, size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
   713	                                  size_t timestep, const val_t* kij,
   714	                                  const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
   715	                                  const val_t* rho, const val_t* allRadiosity,
   716	                                  size_t source, size_t sourceOff, val_t* current) {
   717	    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
   718	    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
   719	    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
   720	    val_t sum = ZERO;
   721	    size_t row = localI * n;
   722	    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
   723	        int delay = tau[row + j];
   724	        val_t factor = kij[row + j];
   725	        if (i == j || timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay) || factor <= ZERO) continue;
   726	        val_t incoming = allRadiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];
   727	        if (incoming > ZERO) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], ONE) * incoming;
   728	    }
   729	    __shared__ val_t partial[256];
   730	    partial[threadIdx.x] = sum;
   731	    __syncthreads();
   732	    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
   733	        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
   734	        __syncthreads();
   735	    }
   736	    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
   737	        current[localI] = rho[i] * partial[0] +
   738	                          ((i == source && timestep < sourceOff) ? ONE : ZERO);
   739	}
   740	
   741	__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t rowStart,
   742	                               size_t rowCount, size_t source,
   743	                               const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances) {
   744	    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
   745	    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
   746	    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
   747	    val_t threadBest = ZERO;
   748	    size_t threadBestT = 0;
   749	    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
   750	        val_t sum = ZERO;
   751	        for (size_t tt = t; tt < timesteps; ++tt) {
   752	            sum += radiosity[tt * n + i] * radiosity[(tt - t) * n + source];
   753	        }
   754	        if (sum > threadBest) {
   755	            threadBest = sum;
   756	            threadBestT = t;
   757	        }
   758	    }
   759	    __shared__ val_t correlations[256];
   760	    __shared__ size_t delays[256];
   761	    correlations[threadIdx.x] = threadBest;
   762	    delays[threadIdx.x] = threadBestT;
   763	    __syncthreads();
   764	    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
   765	        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
   766	            val_t candidate = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
   767	            size_t candidateT = delays[threadIdx.x + stride];
   768	            if (candidate > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
   769	                (candidate == correlations[threadIdx.x] && candidateT < delays[threadIdx.x])) {
   770	                correlations[threadIdx.x] = candidate;
   770	                correlations[threadIdx.x] = candidate;
   771	                delays[threadIdx.x] = candidateT;
   771	                delays[threadIdx.x] = candidateT;
   772	            }
   772	            }
   773	        }
   773	        }
   774	        __syncthreads();
   774	        __syncthreads();
   775	    }
   775	    }
   776	    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
   776	    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
   777	        distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(delays[0]);
   777	        distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(delays[0]);
   778	}
   778	}
   779	
   779	
   780	__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
   780	__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
   781	                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
   781	                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
   782	    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   782	    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   783	    unsigned int local = index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON;
   783	    unsigned int local = index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON;
   784	    // Aggregate within a block to keep validation overhead negligible.
   784	    // Aggregate within a block to keep validation overhead negligible.
   785	    __shared__ unsigned int blockCount[256];
   785	    __shared__ unsigned int blockCount[256];
   786	    blockCount[threadIdx.x] = local;
   786	    blockCount[threadIdx.x] = local;
   787	    __syncthreads();
   787	    __syncthreads();
   788	    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
   788	    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
   789	        if (threadIdx.x < stride) blockCount[threadIdx.x] += blockCount[threadIdx.x + stride];
   789	        if (threadIdx.x < stride) blockCount[threadIdx.x] += blockCount[threadIdx.x + stride];
   790	        __syncthreads();
   790	        __syncthreads();
   791	    }
   792	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) atomicAdd(nonzero, static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockCount[0]));
   793	}
   794	
   795	__global__ void countEnergizedKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t n,
   796	                                     size_t timesteps, unsigned int* energized) {
   797	    size_t triangle = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   798	    if (triangle >= n) return;
   799	    for (size_t t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
   800	        if (radiosity[t * n + triangle] > EPSILON) {
   801	            atomicAdd(energized, 1U);
   802	            return;
   803	        }
   804	    }
   805	}
