   807	// ============================================================================
   808	// Room Response Simulation State
   809	// ============================================================================
   810	
   811	struct SimulationState {
   812	    size_t numTriangles;
   813	    size_t numTimesteps;
   814	
   815	    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;
   816	    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle
   817	    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)
   818	    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source
   819	
   820	    int rank = 0, ranks = 1;
   821	    size_t localStart = 0, localCount = 0;
   822	    std::vector<int> rowCounts, rowDisplacements;
   823	    std::vector<FlatOctreeNode> flatNodes;
   824	    std::vector<uint32_t> flatIndices;
   825	
   826	    Triangle* dTriangles = nullptr;
   827	    FlatOctreeNode* dNodes = nullptr;
   828	    uint32_t* dIndices = nullptr;
   829	    val_t* dAreas = nullptr;
   830	    val_t* dRho = nullptr;
   831	    val_t* dKij = nullptr;
   832	    int* dTau = nullptr;
   833	    val_t* dRadB = nullptr;
   834	    val_t* dCurrent = nullptr;
   835	    val_t* dDistances = nullptr;
   836	    val_t* hostCurrent = nullptr;
   837	    val_t* hostLocal = nullptr;
   838	
   839	    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure
   840	
   841	    size_t sourceIndex;
   842	
   843	};
   844	
   845	// ============================================================================
   846	// Initialization
   847	// ============================================================================
   848	
   849	void initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,
   850	                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {
   851	    // Generate mesh
   852	    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units
   853	    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);
   854	    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();
   855	    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;
   856	    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;
   857	
   858	    if (state.rank == 0)
   859	        printf("Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\n", state.numTriangles);
   860	
   861	    state.rowCounts.resize(state.ranks);
   862	    state.rowDisplacements.resize(state.ranks);
   863	    const size_t base = state.numTriangles / static_cast<size_t>(state.ranks);
   864	    const size_t remainder = state.numTriangles % static_cast<size_t>(state.ranks);
   865	    size_t offset = 0;
   866	    for (int rank = 0; rank < state.ranks; ++rank) {
   867	        size_t count = base + (static_cast<size_t>(rank) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
   868	        state.rowCounts[rank] = static_cast<int>(count);
   869	        state.rowDisplacements[rank] = static_cast<int>(offset);
   870	        if (rank == state.rank) {
   871	            state.localStart = offset;
   872	            state.localCount = count;
   873	        }
   874	        offset += count;
   875	    }
   876	
   877	    // Build octree for spatial acceleration
   878	    if (state.rank == 0) printf("Building octree...\n");
   879	    state.octree.build(state.triangles);
   880	    state.octree.flatten(state.flatNodes, state.flatIndices);
   881	
   882	    // Initialize areas
   883	    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);
   884	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   885	    for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(state.numTriangles); ++i) {
   886	        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();
   887	    }
   888	
   889	    // Initialize reflectivity
   890	    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);
   891	
   892	    // Initialize matrices
   893	    // Kij and Tau stay distributed in GPU memory; retaining full host copies
   894	    // would defeat MPI memory scaling at the largest mesh levels.
   895	    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);
   896	
   897	    // Source emission is generated directly by the propagation kernel for the
   898	    // first half of the timesteps, avoiding another replicated T-by-N array.
   899	}
   900	
   901	void allocateDeviceState(SimulationState& state) {
   902	    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;
   903	    const size_t localMatrix = state.localCount * n;
   904	    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&state.dTriangles, n * sizeof(Triangle)), "triangle allocation");
   905	    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&state.dNodes, state.flatNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode)), "octree allocation");
   906	    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&state.dIndices, state.flatIndices.size() * sizeof(uint32_t)), "octree-index allocation");
   907	    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&state.dAreas, n * sizeof(val_t)), "area allocation");
   908	    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&state.dRho, n * sizeof(val_t)), "reflectivity allocation");
   909	    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&state.dKij, localMatrix * sizeof(val_t)), "form-factor allocation");
   910	    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&state.dTau, localMatrix * sizeof(int)), "delay allocation");
   911	    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&state.dRadB, state.numTimesteps * n * sizeof(val_t)), "radiosity allocation");
   912	    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&state.dCurrent, state.localCount * sizeof(val_t)), "current-row allocation");
   913	    cudaCheck(cudaMalloc(&state.dDistances, state.localCount * sizeof(val_t)), "distance allocation");
   914	    cudaCheck(cudaHostAlloc(&state.hostCurrent, n * sizeof(val_t), cudaHostAllocPortable), "MPI receive staging allocation");
   915	    cudaCheck(cudaHostAlloc(&state.hostLocal, state.localCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaHostAllocPortable), "MPI send staging allocation");
   916	    cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriangles, state.triangles.data(), n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice), "triangle upload");
   917	    cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodes, state.flatNodes.data(), state.flatNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice), "octree upload");
   918	    cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(state.dIndices, state.flatIndices.data(), state.flatIndices.size() * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice), "octree-index upload");
   919	    cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(), n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice), "area upload");
   920	    cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(), n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice), "reflectivity upload");
   921	    cudaCheck(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, state.numTimesteps * n * sizeof(val_t)), "radiosity initialization");
   922	}
   923	
   924	void releaseDeviceState(SimulationState& state) {
   925	    cudaFree(state.dTriangles); cudaFree(state.dNodes); cudaFree(state.dIndices);
   926	    cudaFree(state.dAreas); cudaFree(state.dRho); cudaFree(state.dKij);
   927	    cudaFree(state.dTau); cudaFree(state.dRadB); cudaFree(state.dCurrent);
   928	    cudaFree(state.dDistances); cudaFreeHost(state.hostCurrent); cudaFreeHost(state.hostLocal);
   929	}
   930	
   931	// ============================================================================
   932	// Precomputation Phase
   933	// ============================================================================
   934	
   935	void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
   936	    if (state.rank == 0) printf("Computing form factors (Kij)...\n");
   937	    const size_t work = state.localCount * state.numTriangles;
   938	    constexpr int blockSize = 128;
   939	    precomputeKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>((work + blockSize - 1) / blockSize), blockSize>>>(
   940	        state.dTriangles, state.dNodes, state.dIndices, state.numTriangles,
   941	        state.localStart, state.localCount, state.dKij, state.dTau);
   942	    cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError(), "precomputation kernel launch");
   943	    cudaCheck(cudaDeviceSynchronize(), "precomputation kernel");
   944	}
   945	
   946	void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {
   947	    if (state.rank == 0) printf("Computing time delays (Tau)...\n");
   948	    // Delays and form factors share one launch to reuse triangle data and avoid
   949	    // a second traversal of the distributed N-by-N row block.
   950	}
   951	
   952	// ============================================================================
   953	// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)
   954	// ============================================================================
   955	
   956	void runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {
   957	    if (state.rank == 0) printf("Running wave propagation simulation...\n");
   958	    constexpr int blockSize = 256;
   959	    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
   960	        propagationKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>(state.localCount), blockSize>>>(
   961	            state.numTriangles, state.localStart, state.localCount, t,
   962	            state.dKij, state.dTau, state.dAreas, state.dRho, state.dRadB,
   963	            state.sourceIndex, state.numTimesteps / 2, state.dCurrent);
   964	        cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError(), "propagation kernel launch");
   965	        cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(state.hostLocal, state.dCurrent,
   966	                             state.localCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
   967	                  "local radiosity download");
   968	        MPI_Allgatherv(state.hostLocal, static_cast<int>(state.localCount), MPI_FLOAT,
   969	                       state.hostCurrent, state.rowCounts.data(),
   970	                       state.rowDisplacements.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   971	        cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(state.dRadB + t * state.numTriangles, state.hostCurrent,
   972	                             state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
   973	                  "global radiosity upload");
   974	        if (state.rank == 0 && ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps)) {
   975	            printf("  Timestep %zu/%zu\n", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);
   976	        }
   977	    }
   978	}
   979	
   980	// ============================================================================
   981	// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)
   982	// ============================================================================
   983	
   984	void computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {
   985	    if (state.rank == 0) printf("Computing distances via cross-correlation...\n");
   986	    constexpr int blockSize = 256;
   987	    distanceKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>(state.localCount), blockSize>>>(
   988	        state.numTriangles, state.numTimesteps, state.localStart, state.localCount,
   989	        state.sourceIndex, state.dRadB, state.dDistances);
   990	    cudaCheck(cudaGetLastError(), "distance kernel launch");
   991	    cudaCheck(cudaMemcpy(state.hostLocal, state.dDistances,
   992	                         state.localCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
   993	              "distance download");
   994	    MPI_Gatherv(state.hostLocal, static_cast<int>(state.localCount), MPI_FLOAT,
   995	                state.distances.data(), state.rowCounts.data(),
   996	                state.rowDisplacements.data(), MPI_FLOAT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   997	}

  1003	bool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {
  1004	    if (state.rank == 0) printf("\nValidation:\n");
  1005	
  1006	    // Check that distances are non-negative
  1007	    bool allNonNegative = true;
  1008	    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
  1009	    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
  1010	    val_t sumDist = ZERO;

  1121	void printUsage(const char* progName) {
  1122	    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
  1123	    printf("Options:\n");
  1124	    printf("  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\n");
  1125	    printf("               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\n");
  1126	    printf("               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\n");
  1127	    printf("  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\n");
  1128	    printf("  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\n");
  1129	    printf("  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\n");
  1130	    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
  1131	    printf("  -o           Print results for external validation\n");
  1132	    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
  1133	}
  1134	
  1135	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  1136	    int provided = 0;
  1137	    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);
  1138	    int rank = 0, ranks = 1;
  1139	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
  1140	    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &ranks);
  1141	    if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
  1142	        if (rank == 0) std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI does not provide required thread support\n");
  1143	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
  1144	    }
  1145	
  1146	    MPI_Comm localCommunicator;
  1147	    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank,
  1148	                        MPI_INFO_NULL, &localCommunicator);
  1149	    int localRank = 0;
  1150	    MPI_Comm_rank(localCommunicator, &localRank);
  1151	    int deviceCount = 0;
  1152	    cudaCheck(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount), "GPU discovery");
  1153	    if (deviceCount == 0) {
  1154	        if (rank == 0) std::fprintf(stderr, "roomsim requires at least one CUDA GPU per node\n");

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA kernels
+// ============================================================================

+__device__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t sample01(uint32_t i, uint32_t j, uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    uint32_t x = 42U ^ (i * 0x9e3779b9U) ^ (j * 0x85ebca6bU) ^
+                 (ray * 0xc2b2ae35U) ^ (lane * 0x27d4eb2fU);
+    return static_cast<val_t>(mixBits(x) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 sampledPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint32_t i, uint32_t j,
+                             uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    val_t u = sample01(i, j, ray, lane);
+    val_t v = sample01(i, j, ray, lane + 1U);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool segmentIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                     const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    return fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) <=
+           node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceRayTriangle(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                   const Triangle& triangle) {
+    Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 p = direction.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(p);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tv = origin - triangle.a;
+    val_t u = tv.dot(p) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    Vec3 q = tv.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = direction.dot(q) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return e2.dot(q) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                 const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices,
+                                 uint32_t triangleCount, uint32_t src, uint32_t dst) {
+    Vec3 delta = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = delta.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 direction = delta / rayLength;
+    // The generated octree is shallow; the guarded stack avoids recursion and
+    // falls back to a complete scan if a future mesh produces excessive fanout.
+    int stack[64];
+    int top = 0;
+    stack[top++] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                uint32_t index = indices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && segmentIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (top == 64) {
+                        // Correctness-preserving rare overflow path.
+                        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < triangleCount; ++index) {
+                            if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                            val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+                        }
+                        return false;
+                    }
+                    stack[top++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices, size_t n,
+                                 size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                 val_t* kij, int* tau) {
+    size_t linear = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    size_t total = rowCount * n;
+    if (linear >= total) return;
+    size_t localI = linear / n;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    size_t j = linear - localI * n;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        tau[linear] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 centers = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[linear] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(centers.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    if (triangles[i].normal().dot(triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t factor = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pi = sampledPoint(triangles[i], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 0);
+        Vec3 pj = sampledPoint(triangles[j], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 2);
+        if (rayBlockedDevice(pi, pj, triangles, nodes, indices, static_cast<uint32_t>(n),
+                             static_cast<uint32_t>(i), static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) continue;
+        Vec3 v = pj - pi;
+        val_t distance2 = v.squaredNorm();
+        if (distance2 < EPSILON) continue;
+        val_t inverseLength = rsqrtf(distance2);
+        val_t ci = fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(triangles[i].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        val_t cj = fmaxf(ZERO, (-v).dot(triangles[j].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        if (ci > ZERO && cj > ZERO) factor += ci * cj / (PI * distance2);
+    }
+    kij[linear] = factor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(size_t n, size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                  size_t timestep, const val_t* kij,
+                                  const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                  const val_t* rho, const val_t* allRadiosity,
+                                  size_t source, size_t sourceOff, val_t* current) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    size_t row = localI * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        int delay = tau[row + j];
+        val_t factor = kij[row + j];
+        if (i == j || timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay) || factor <= ZERO) continue;
+        val_t incoming = allRadiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];
+        if (incoming > ZERO) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], ONE) * incoming;
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t partial[256];
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        current[localI] = rho[i] * partial[0] +
+                          ((i == source && timestep < sourceOff) ? ONE : ZERO);
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t rowStart,
+                               size_t rowCount, size_t source,
+                               const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t threadBest = ZERO;
+    size_t threadBestT = 0;
+    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t tt = t; tt < timesteps; ++tt) {
+            sum += radiosity[tt * n + i] * radiosity[(tt - t) * n + source];
+        }
+        if (sum > threadBest) {
+            threadBest = sum;
+            threadBestT = t;
+        }
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t correlations[256];
+    __shared__ size_t delays[256];
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = threadBest;
+    delays[threadIdx.x] = threadBestT;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t candidate = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            size_t candidateT = delays[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidate > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidate == correlations[threadIdx.x] && candidateT < delays[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = candidate;
+                delays[threadIdx.x] = candidateT;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(delays[0]);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    unsigned int local = index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON;
+    // Aggregate within a block to keep validation overhead negligible.
+    __shared__ unsigned int blockCount[256];
+    blockCount[threadIdx.x] = local;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) blockCount[threadIdx.x] += blockCount[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) atomicAdd(nonzero, static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockCount[0]));
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergizedKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t n,
+                                     size_t timesteps, unsigned int* energized) {
+    size_t triangle = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * n + triangle] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(energized, 1U);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}
+

codex
Implemented the unconditional hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA version without adding files or changing the executable name.

Key changes:

- MPI row-wise domain decomposition with per-rank GPU selection.
- CUDA kernels for form factors, octree visibility, delays, wave propagation, correlation, and validation.
- OpenMP host initialization and validation reductions.
- Distributed `Kij`/`Tau` storage and pinned MPI staging buffers.
- Deterministic sampling independent of MPI rank count.
- Updated required CUDA/MPI/OpenMP CMake configuration.

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA kernels
+// ============================================================================
+
+__device__ uint32_t mixBits(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352dU;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bU;
+    return x ^ (x >> 16);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t sample01(uint32_t i, uint32_t j, uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    uint32_t x = 42U ^ (i * 0x9e3779b9U) ^ (j * 0x85ebca6bU) ^
+                 (ray * 0xc2b2ae35U) ^ (lane * 0x27d4eb2fU);
+    return static_cast<val_t>(mixBits(x) >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 sampledPoint(const Triangle& triangle, uint32_t i, uint32_t j,
+                             uint32_t ray, uint32_t lane) {
+    val_t u = sample01(i, j, ray, lane);
+    val_t v = sample01(i, j, ray, lane + 1U);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool segmentIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                     const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    return fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) <=
+           node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t deviceRayTriangle(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                   const Triangle& triangle) {
+    Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    Vec3 p = direction.cross(e2);
+    val_t det = e1.dot(p);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    Vec3 tv = origin - triangle.a;
+    val_t u = tv.dot(p) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    Vec3 q = tv.cross(e1);
+    val_t v = direction.dot(q) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return e2.dot(q) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                 const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices,
+                                 uint32_t triangleCount, uint32_t src, uint32_t dst) {
+    Vec3 delta = to - from;
+    val_t rayLength = delta.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    Vec3 direction = delta / rayLength;
+    // The generated octree is shallow; the guarded stack avoids recursion and
+    // falls back to a complete scan if a future mesh produces excessive fanout.
+    int stack[64];
+    int top = 0;
+    stack[top++] = 0;
+    while (top) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--top]];
+        if (node.triangleCount) {
+            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triangleCount; ++k) {
+                uint32_t index = indices[node.firstTriangle + k];
+                if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+        } else {
+            for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+                int childIndex = node.children[child];
+                if (childIndex >= 0 && segmentIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                    if (top == 64) {
+                        // Correctness-preserving rare overflow path.
+                        for (uint32_t index = 0; index < triangleCount; ++index) {
+                            if (index == src || index == dst) continue;
+                            val_t distance = deviceRayTriangle(from, direction, triangles[index]);
+                            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+                        }
+                        return false;
+                    }
+                    stack[top++] = childIndex;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void precomputeKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                 const uint32_t* indices, size_t n,
+                                 size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                 val_t* kij, int* tau) {
+    size_t linear = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    size_t total = rowCount * n;
+    if (linear >= total) return;
+    size_t localI = linear / n;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    size_t j = linear - localI * n;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        tau[linear] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    Vec3 centers = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    tau[linear] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(centers.norm() * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    if (triangles[i].normal().dot(triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[linear] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t factor = ZERO;
+    for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        Vec3 pi = sampledPoint(triangles[i], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 0);
+        Vec3 pj = sampledPoint(triangles[j], static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                               static_cast<uint32_t>(j), ray, 2);
+        if (rayBlockedDevice(pi, pj, triangles, nodes, indices, static_cast<uint32_t>(n),
+                             static_cast<uint32_t>(i), static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) continue;
+        Vec3 v = pj - pi;
+        val_t distance2 = v.squaredNorm();
+        if (distance2 < EPSILON) continue;
+        val_t inverseLength = rsqrtf(distance2);
+        val_t ci = fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(triangles[i].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        val_t cj = fmaxf(ZERO, (-v).dot(triangles[j].normal()) * inverseLength);
+        if (ci > ZERO && cj > ZERO) factor += ci * cj / (PI * distance2);
+    }
+    kij[linear] = factor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagationKernel(size_t n, size_t rowStart, size_t rowCount,
+                                  size_t timestep, const val_t* kij,
+                                  const int* tau, const val_t* areas,
+                                  const val_t* rho, const val_t* allRadiosity,
+                                  size_t source, size_t sourceOff, val_t* current) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    size_t row = localI * n;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < n; j += blockDim.x) {
+        int delay = tau[row + j];
+        val_t factor = kij[row + j];
+        if (i == j || timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay) || factor <= ZERO) continue;
+        val_t incoming = allRadiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * n + j];
+        if (incoming > ZERO) sum += fminf(factor * areas[j], ONE) * incoming;
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t partial[256];
+    partial[threadIdx.x] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        current[localI] = rho[i] * partial[0] +
+                          ((i == source && timestep < sourceOff) ? ONE : ZERO);
+}
+
+__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t n, size_t timesteps, size_t rowStart,
+                               size_t rowCount, size_t source,
+                               const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances) {
+    size_t localI = blockIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= rowCount) return;
+    size_t i = rowStart + localI;
+    val_t threadBest = ZERO;
+    size_t threadBestT = 0;
+    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t tt = t; tt < timesteps; ++tt) {
+            sum += radiosity[tt * n + i] * radiosity[(tt - t) * n + source];
+        }
+        if (sum > threadBest) {
+            threadBest = sum;
+            threadBestT = t;
+        }
+    }
+    __shared__ val_t correlations[256];
+    __shared__ size_t delays[256];
+    correlations[threadIdx.x] = threadBest;
+    delays[threadIdx.x] = threadBestT;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {
+            val_t candidate = correlations[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            size_t candidateT = delays[threadIdx.x + stride];
+            if (candidate > correlations[threadIdx.x] ||
+                (candidate == correlations[threadIdx.x] && candidateT < delays[threadIdx.x])) {
+                correlations[threadIdx.x] = candidate;
+                delays[threadIdx.x] = candidateT;
+            }
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0)
+        distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(delays[0]);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    unsigned int local = index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON;
+    // Aggregate within a block to keep validation overhead negligible.
+    __shared__ unsigned int blockCount[256];
+    blockCount[threadIdx.x] = local;
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (unsigned int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride; stride >>= 1) {
+        if (threadIdx.x < stride) blockCount[threadIdx.x] += blockCount[threadIdx.x + stride];
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) atomicAdd(nonzero, static_cast<unsigned long long>(blockCount[0]));
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergizedKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t n,
+                                     size_t timesteps, unsigned int* energized) {
+    size_t triangle = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (triangle >= n) return;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * n + triangle] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(energized, 1U);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
